name: Fishmeal; indirect steam dried press cake; at plant; moisture content 5-10%
description: This unit process is a cradle-to-gate dataset of production of 1 kg  fishmeal. The unit process was based on meta data from the LCA Food Database (http://www.lcafood.dk/).
category: 31-33: Manufacturing/3117: Seafood Product Preparation and Packaging

processDocumentation.timeDescription: LCI data was based on meta data from the LCA Food Database (http://www.lcafood.dk/) and is based on data collected from a factory in Denmark in 2000.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: LCI data was based on meta data from the LCA Food Database (http://www.lcafood.dk/) and is based on a Danish fishmeal factory. It has been altered for use as a surroate for US production by utilizing processes with US electricity from the DataSmart database.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: The unit process was based on meta data from the LCA Food Database (http://www.lcafood.dk/). Production includes boiling of fish, pressing, centrifigal seperation of oils, and drying by indirect steam to a moisture content of 5-10%. It was then cooled and milled into fishmeal.
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Life cycle inventory was originally assembled using the SimaPro software platform (Version 8.0.4.26) and was modified for submission using the OpenLCA platform (Version 1.3.0).
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: Land use and water use are not included.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: This is a cradle-to-gate process for the production of fishmeal. It does not include the fish or the impacts associated with fishing.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Adopted from the LCA Food Database (http://www.lcafood.dk/). All unit processes in the original model were replaced with US-EI v2.2. Original source stated 171 l natural gas. To increase representativeness, this has been calculated to an average heat in the fish industry. The energy content of natural gas was assumed to be 36.3 kJ/L.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: The authors in their metadata specify that all data are derived from TrippleNine’s May and June record in 2000 when 100% of fish-input was sandeel http://www.lcafood.dk/processes/industry/fishmealproduction.htm
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Data was collected during an ongoing project from 2013 through 2015.

sources.name: Development of Life Cycle Inventory data for U.S. Swine Production Scenarios

reviews.details: University of Arkansas swine dataset mapped to USLCI technosphere flows and FEDEFL elementary flows for publication on the Federal LCA Commons. Review covers mapping crosswalks, cutoff flows, and export structure.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: These data may be used in Situation C2, “Accounting without interactions.”  This is applicable to accounting studies that according to their goal definition do not include any interaction with other systems.
processDocumentation.projectDescription: Data were prepared by the University of Arkansas Center for Agricultural and Rural Sustainability for the United States Department of Agriculture National Agriculture Library.  This project was supported in part by the National Pork Board.
